test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 02 May 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The cost price of the box of pens is Rs. 400. The shopkeeper gave 10% of discount on the cost price. What will be the selling price?
solution:
**Given:**

Cost Price (C.P.) of a box of pens = Rs. 400

Discount given = 10% of C.P.

**Formula: **

Selling Price (S.P.) = C.P. - Discount

**Calculation:**

⇒ Discount = 10/100 × Rs. 400 = Rs. 40

⇒ S.P. = C.P. - Discount = Rs. 400 - Rs. 40

S.P. = Rs. 360

**Therefore, the selling price of the box of pens will be Rs. 360.**
